blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Thousands were set to protest in Manila against Donald Trump on Tuesday ahead of his arrival at a summit that the US leader will seek to dominate despite bruising election losses. Around 2,000 demonstrators were already facing off with riot shield-wielding police while carrying banners reading “Trump out now” and “Reject Pax Silica”, a reference to a US supply chain initiative that has divided opinions in the Philippines. The US president’s streamlined agenda will send him straight to a meeting of the so-called Quad security alliance, with India’s Narendra Modi, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi of Japan and Australia’s […]...
